title: CommitRequest
description: Input contract for crystalium.commit(). Every commit funnels through enforcement.assert_tier_allowed() before any store mutation (MISSION.md §Keystone). Gates traversed: G1, G2, G4, G5, G7.

layer.description: Target memory layer for this commit.

payload.description: Crystal payload (all fields except id, which the server assigns). Must match crystal.v1.json minus id.

provenance.description: Provenance of the commit (author, source, task context).

caller_tier.description: Trust tier of the calling agent. Enforcement uses this to gate the commit (G1, G2, G4).

force_promote.description: T0-only: skip pending_promotions queue and commit directly. Audit trail is via telemetry (OQ-1).
